name: Umar Shaikh Mirza II
role: Timurid ruler of Fergana from 1469 to 1494

checks.lead: Umar Shaikh Mirza II (Persian: عمر شیخ میرزا دوم; 1456–1494) was the Timurid ruler of the Fergana Valley. He was the fourth son of Abu Sa'id Mirza, the ruler of the Timurid Empire in what is now Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Afghanistan, Tajikistan and eastern Iran.
